title: Chapter 1877: Treasure Urn (I)
content:
Chapter 1877: Treasure Urn (I)

Though Shehu was not particularly capable, his many years of cultivation had given him enough discernment to recognize the treasure overhead.

Terrified, he cried out, "Daoist Masters... might there be some misunderstanding? I have cultivated here for many years and have never done anything to offend you..."

Though he pleaded for mercy, he acted without the slightest hesitation. He twisted swiftly, and his brown robes flared outward. He transformed into a brown-feathered, yellow swan as large as a mountain. Yet beneath its feathers were a pair of sharp claws. Its vertically slit pupils were fierce and cruel, like those of a wolf.

The demon's bloodline was extraordinary. His transformation shook the earth and mountains, revealing a blood-red belly. Bracing both feet beneath the heavenly gate, he strained upward in an attempt to lift it.

Yet the man in black armor stood atop the gate like Mount Taishi. No matter how much power Shehu drew from his divine abilities, the gate did not budge in the slightest. As the brilliant divine ability pressed down, the scroll in the man's hand lit up as well!

Boom!

Countless precipitous peaks rose beneath the mighty fortress, their white stones sharp as swords. Aspects of Bright Yang appeared, and bells and drums rang together. A river wound down through the peaks, sealing divine ability in every direction!

Shehu's face visibly paled. "No... My life is in danger!"

Before he could think further, a faint command reached his ears. Everything around him visibly twisted, and flames so bright he could scarcely keep his eyes open surged toward him, about to pour over his dharma body.

Though Shehu's [Back Facing South] was remarkably effective at evading fire, the divine ability had a flaw. [Back Facing South] depended on 'movement.' Once suppressed and sealed away from heaven and earth, he could no longer evade even fire!

A chill pierced his bones. His enormous body immediately shrank back, transforming back into human form. Sweeping his sleeve, he released a walnut-sized jewel that spun and bloomed with green light, shielding him from the fire.

[Orthodox Wood] drew upon the aspect of Metal, and feared fire least among the Wood Virtues. But he was facing the infamous Merging Fire! The green light immediately weakened in the raging flames, dissolving into wisps of black smoke.

Horrified, the demonic creature cried out, "Exalted Immortals, have I offended you somehow? Has someone maliciously set you against me?"

No answer came from outside. The flames flickered, and a streak of golden light leaped out!

It was a radiant halberd, its curved blade like the moon!

Shehu swept his sleeve and summoned the bronze basin once again. A shattering sound rang out as another image of the halberd emerged from beneath layers of bronze light and struck the green radiance.

Crack!

The jewel was only a spirit embryo, already deteriorating at a terrifying rate before the Merging Fire. How could it withstand that blow? It shattered into fragments, and the raging flames immediately rushed toward him.

Fear seized Shehu. He opened his great mouth, revealing rows of densely packed fangs. Within his maw, blood flowed in rivers, white bones formed towers, and countless Yin souls surged and wailed!

The great demon formed a seal and blew. "

Awoo!

"

A shriek like clashing metal and stone and rumbling thunder resounded through heaven and earth. Surging Yin Qi burst forth, finally causing the infinitely radiant heavenly gate to tremble.

At last, Li Zhouwei looked at him directly and nodded. "So those centuries of cultivation were not entirely wasted!"

With his Fate Divine Ability active, Li Ximing also saw it clearly and nodded inwardly.

Had that Yin shriek not been suppressed by both a divine ability and a spirit treasure, it would have been quite formidable. At the very least, it could have forced Li Ximing to stop attacking and defend himself with all his strength. If caught unprepared, he might even have been injured!

Dense golden patterns lit up across Li Zhouwei's face. He left his halberd standing in the air, then spread both hands and pressed them down upon the heavenly gate.

The trembling heavenly gate steadied once more.

Who knew how many years Shehu had spent cultivating that breath of Yin Qi? It was as vast as an ocean and as boundless as a desert. Though [Heavenly Crow Merging Fire] and the [Heaven-Venerating Gate] continuously wore it down and held it back, the space beneath the gate grew darker and darker.

But that was all it could do. The darkness persisted for nearly an hour before finally fading. The demon's voice rang out again, seemingly pleading for mercy while actually probing them.

Li Ximing could not help saying, "The combination of the [Huai River Map] and the [Heaven-Venerating Gate]... is truly terrifying."

Li Ximing sighed in amazement, but Li Zhouwei shook his head. "His art is not weak. Unfortunately for him, [Heaven-Venerating Gate] can already suppress Yin and evil while also dispelling resentment. If he cultivated another Dao lineage, he might have been able to shake my divine ability through sustained effort."

Standing amidst the surging Merging Fire, tears streamed from Shehu's eyes, and every part of his face ached. The power he had accumulated over centuries had been exhausted in a single struggle, leaving him unable to use his arts.

At last, he gave up concealing the truth and cried out, "Since you have come from Jiangnan, you must know of my past. I am willing to offer the spirit root to you both, my lords. I ask only that you spare my life!"

The Merging Fire continued to rage without relenting. The divine ability overhead, supported by the spirit treasure, wielded boundless power. No matter how he struggled, he could not shake it in the slightest. As wisp after wisp of brilliant white flame leaped toward his dharma body, Shehu fell into despair.

[Bright Yang] is overpowering, and [Merging Fire] is vicious. My life is over!

How could Shehu not know the power of Bright Yang? [Heaven-Venerating Gate] was especially renowned. If his divine abilities surpassed those of the young man above, or if he could at least fight him to a standstill, there would be little to fear from it. But he was inferior in both divine abilities and Dao conduct. Now suppressed beneath the gate, he could cry to heaven and earth for help and receive no answer!

Against another divine ability, I might still have a chance. But with this art above me, and my only Valley Water talisman already used...

Though he knew he had no hope of survival, he still cried out, "I offer everything I own and my life as well! I ask only that you let a fragment of my true spirit escape!"

As he suffered within the Merging Fire, Li Ximing rode the heavenly light outside, holding two fingers together before him to direct the flames. He sounded pleasantly surprised. "A spirit root! He really does have something worthwhile!"

Without relaxing his efforts in the slightest, he observed the situation within. Seeing that the demon had indeed reached the end of his rope, he could not help remarking, "That was surprisingly easy! I worried too much."

Li Zhouwei, however, was unsurprised. Examining the spirit treasure in his hand, he replied, "It was hardly easy, granduncle. With you and I acting together and our spirit treasures brought to bear... naturally, a demon king from this remote corner would be easy to capture!

"We only need to guard against him destroying everything in a desperate final act."

The Merging Fire burned for another fifteen minutes before Li Ximing transformed into heavenly light and descended into it.

This was only the second time Shehu had felt such despair since attaining divine ability. Just as beneath the pagoda of Shejie, the Seventh Incarnation Maha, he had no chance of escape. The despair and loneliness of those days flooded back, leaving him trembling. The scriptures even began to echo in his ears again.

"I submit... I submit... Please let me out!"

His offers had failed to persuade them, yet these words seemed remarkably effective. The Merging Fire around him dissipated, leaving Shehu kneeling beneath the divine ability, his clothes torn and his body covered in ash and flames.

Seeing Li Ximing approach on a streak of light, he made a show of weeping and asked no more questions. "I am willing to serve you however you wish, my lord..."

Li Ximing shook his head. "When your kind attain the Dao, your spirituality is refined back into your divine abilities. How could I possibly make you serve me? We have both attained divine abilities. There is no need for such empty words."
